Preserve reference packaging shapes, caps, label designs and visible reference wording/languages, logos and colors. Omega is amber with black cap, pale beige label and muted coral band, original wording as in ref2 (do not substitute an old label); chlorophyll white plastic with mint label and green band. No invented new branding.
